newsitem.title: USA: Union Electric Co Q4 net declines.
newsitem.headline: Union Electric Co Q4 net declines.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 operating expenses $426.7 million vs $409.0 million.
Q4 1996 earnings cut by $0.18 a share due to Callaway Nuclear Plant refueling.
Q4 1996 net results also included $0.03 a share in costs for proposed merger with CIPSCO Inc.
Q4 1996 net income before $3,313,000 in preferred dividends vs $3,312,000 a year ago.
YEAR
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include $0.08/ a share in costs for proposed CIPSCO merger, which the company said it expected to be completed by the end of 1997.

1996 revenues were reduced by a $47 million credit to Missouri electric customers, which cut full-year earnings by $0.27 a share. The credit is part of a three-year experimental alternative rate regulation plan.
1996 net income before $13,249,000 in preferred dividends vs $13,250,000.
Full-year 1995 results include $0.20 a share expense for the previous refueling of the Callaway Nuclear Plant. The next refueling is scheduled for the spring of 1998.
((Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
